exposure: mode of delivery (Caesarean Section or Vaginal delivery)
cohort: Term neonates born at KIMS Hospital Karad between December 2013 and February 2015.
finding: A statistically significant relationship was found between mode of delivery and blood glucose levels in newborns at 24 hours.
mod_finding: Mean blood glucose levels at 24 hours were significantly higher in neonates born by vaginal delivery (65.18 mg/dl) compared to those born by cesarean section (62.23 mg/dl).
